items.name: a golden warrior's shield embossed with massive dragon's head design
items.tap: a golden warrior's shield embossed with massive dragon's head design
items.description: An intricate relief detailing an elongated dragon's head showcases the craftsman's keen sense of capturing the specific traits of the imposing beast.  A series of sharp ivory tusks extend from a horned ridge that crests the creature's forehead, finishing with one that protrudes from between its flared nostrils.  Serving as eyes, large cabochon crystals reflect an eerie green hue from beneath a heavily scaled brow, split by thin spikes of black onyx, adding to ominous appearance of the shield.
